pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

2. Which response best shows understanding of Pranayam? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Pranayam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Pranayam has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pranayam.
   D. Use Pranayam to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Which response best shows understanding of The Enlightened Beings Introductory stories? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Enlightened Beings Introductory stories.
   B. Use The Enlightened Beings Introductory stories to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say The Enlightened Beings Introductory stories has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of The Enlightened Beings Introductory stories with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Self-awareness? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Self-awareness.
   B. Say Self-awareness has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Self-awareness to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Self-awareness with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Social festivals? (1 mark)
   A. Say Social festivals has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Social festivals to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Social festivals with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Social festivals.

6. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

7. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

8. Which response best shows understanding of General Etiquette? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of General Etiquette with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use General Etiquette to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say General Etiquette has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing General Etiquette.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Evening Prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Evening Prayer.
   B. Apply the teaching of Evening Prayer with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Evening Prayer has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Evening Prayer to insult classmates of other faiths.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Bhagwat Gita? (1 mark)
   A. Say Bhagwat Gita has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Bhagwat Gita to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Bhagwat Gita with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bhagwat Gita.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Pranayam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain General Etiquette and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Social festivals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Self-awareness and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. A — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

2. A — Apply the teaching of Pranayam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. D — Apply the teaching of The Enlightened Beings Introductory stories with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. D — Apply the teaching of Self-awareness with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. C — Apply the teaching of Social festivals with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. A — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

7. D — Telling the truth and keeping trust

8. A — Apply the teaching of General Etiquette with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. B — Apply the teaching of Evening Prayer with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. C — Apply the teaching of Bhagwat Gita with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Pranayam; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

12. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of General Etiquette; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Social festivals; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Self-awareness; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
